caption: The drawing depicts a detailed design of the left side and partial front of a card table. The visible portion of the table has a curved contour along the top edge and is supported by a single, slender, vertically fluted leg with a turned foot. The top surface of the table is shaded in brown, indicating a wood texture. The apron below the tabletop features panels in tones of yellow, brown, and gold, likely suggesting different wood grains or inlays. The illustration is rendered in pencil with selective application of colored pencil or watercolor to emphasize wood tones and highlights. Faint pencil lines extend horizontally to the right, outlining the rest of the table without color or shading. On the top right of the page, handwritten text reads: "Card table Sheraton Mahogany Bird Eye Maple American 1800." The lower-right corner features a signature, "M. Sand." The background of the drawing is a plain, off-white or lightly aged paper.
title: Sheraton Card Table
